$comment: validate the placement of a requested Default derive: on types that can satisfy it, and not on types that cannot or that generate a Default impl of their own

plain-widget.$comment: derives Default: every field type can

serial-widget.$comment: cannot derive Default: the required serial is a non-zero integer

widget-holder.$comment: cannot derive Default: it requires a type that cannot

defaulted-widget.$comment: generates its own Default impl from the schema default; the derive would conflict

settled-widget.$comment: generates its own Default impl because every property has a default

widget-kind.$comment: enums cannot derive Default without a designated variant

defaulted-widget-kind.$comment: generates its own Default impl from the schema default

kind-holder.$comment: derives Default: its required enum has a Default impl of its own
